texto.@es: -(으)ㄹ 텐데 presenta una expectativa como trasfondo; -아/어도 marca una condición que no cambia el resultado.
texto.@en: - (으) - 텐데 presents an expectation as a background; -아/어도 marks a condition that does not change the result.

texto.@en: 비가 올 텐데 우산을 가져가세요. 비가 와도 행사는 해요. = It looks like it's gonna rain, so wear an umbrella. Even if it rains, the event is still going on.
